title: I created a super chill browser fishing game with Claude (Free, no IAP, no sign up, play in browser)
author: jeffguitars
selftext:
It's absolutely crazy how fast Claude and other programs are advancing. In 12 hours I went from wanting to experiment with drawing realistic water in browser using AI to having a fully playable multiplayer browser game. It feels like we are at a point where anything you can imagine, can be materialized in-game. I truly think we are in a new era of gaming where the only limit is the imagination. To make this, I literally just started in Claude desktop app with an empty project folder and asked it what makes video game water realistic. Two messages later there was a working fully 3d prototype of really nice looking water. After lots of tinkering and adjusting, I thought it would be way more fun to actually have a game around it rather than just walking around staring at how pretty the water was (which I did for probably too long).  
It truly felt like anything that popped into my head was just a sentence away from being reality. Add a feature? "Add this feature". Add an asset? "Generate this asset". Improve performance? "Improve performance". Absolutely a wild experience.  
I used CC0 assets for most of the models, but generated a few also. Thats something else I wanted to touch on. The way you can feed it assets and it can recognize and generate models in the same style is uncanny. It really was as simple as "Generate and fully implement 30 new fish. Make them in the same style as the existing ones." Theres day/night cycle, weather, hiscores, chat effects and item linking, all sorts of stuff.   
Give it a shot and let me know what you think! Nothing to pay for or sign up for, this is just for fun! It loads faster on chrome based browsers since apparently they can compile shaders in parallel but it will still work on other browsers it just takes longer to load on them.   
Gentle reminder I just made this for fun, and I can't wait to see how much more advanced AI becomes especially in gaming and the possibilities it opens up.

[https://www.elderwild.net](https://www.elderwild.net)
